summary: Completed architecture audit of 6 candidates against RULEBOOK_ARCHITECTURE_V5.md. All tests executed in isolated environments with temporary collections. No production data modified.

critical_bugs.title: Retry Resume Idempotency Violation
critical_bugs.issue: retry() endpoint returns existing retry ID without persisting new start_key alias via bind_start_alias()
critical_bugs.impact: New start_key after retry completion creates duplicate retry instead of returning existing one
critical_bugs.reproduction: Isolated test confirmed: K1 creates retry, retry completes, K2 creates new retry (should return K1's retry)
critical_bugs.rule_violation: V2 pp13-18: Identical retry returns original durable outcome. Changed body conflicts.

critical_bugs.title: Concurrent Publication Not Serialized
critical_bugs.issue: publish() inserts tejas_versions row BEFORE CAS update on sets collection
critical_bugs.impact: Concurrent publishes create orphaned version rows when one CAS fails
critical_bugs.reproduction: Isolated test confirmed: Both threads insert version rows, only one CAS succeeds, orphaned row persists
critical_bugs.rule_violation: V5 pp29-31: Atomic operations required. Version insertion should be after successful CAS.

critical_bugs.title: Lost Updates in Concurrent Editing
critical_bugs.issue: edit_question() uses read-modify-write pattern without revision guard on read
critical_bugs.impact: Concurrent edits to different fields cause last-write-wins, losing earlier changes
critical_bugs.reproduction: Isolated test confirmed: Editor 1 changes text, Editor 2 changes topic, final state loses Editor 1's text change
critical_bugs.rule_violation: V5 pp29-31: Mutations must scope to version/preconditions. No revision guard on read allows lost updates.

critical_bugs.title: Unknown Audience Fails Open
critical_bugs.issue: permitted() only checks audience=='restricted', returns True for all unknown values. SetInput accepts any string.
critical_bugs.impact: Invalid audience values (e.g., 'private-typo') pass validation and permit access
critical_bugs.reproduction: Direct function test confirmed: audience='private-typo', 'internal', '' all return True
critical_bugs.rule_violation: V5 pp13-22: Security gates must fail closed. Unknown values should deny access, not permit.

critical_bugs.title: Jobs Admission Lane Has No Drain After Overflow
critical_bugs.issue: run_job() returns immediately when lane is full. No automatic retry when capacity frees.
critical_bugs.impact: Overflowed jobs wait up to 15 minutes for maintenance() cron. Unbounded delay possible.
critical_bugs.reproduction: Isolated test confirmed: Lane fills, 3rd job overflows, 1st job completes, overflow job not retried
critical_bugs.rule_violation: V5 pp46-52: Bounded attempts, visible failure. No unbounded application timer. Overflow creates unbounded delay.

critical_bugs.title: Extraction Destination Fencing Gap
critical_bugs.issue: require_lease() check at line 89 is not atomic with sets.update_one() at line 91
critical_bugs.impact: Stale worker can modify sets collection even if job CAS fails. Lease replacement between check and write.
critical_bugs.reproduction: Isolated test confirmed: Worker 1 checks lease (valid), lease replaced, Worker 1 writes to sets (succeeds), Worker 1 job CAS fails
critical_bugs.rule_violation: V5 pp29-31: Fenced authority required. Destination write must be atomic with lease check or use fenced token.

architectural_gaps.gap: Retry resume does not persist all start_key aliases during active state
Version history insertion not atomic with publication CAS
Question editing lacks revision guard on read, causing lost updates
Access control fails open for unknown audience values
Job lane overflow has no drain mechanism, relies on 15min cron
Extraction destination write not fenced with lease token
